system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Generates a full seasonal plan with stage-wise schedule, input requirements, and activity milestones for a horticulture crop. For your information, my season_type is dummy_season_type_7881, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_8377, my location is dummy_location_6939.

function.name: horti_get_seasonal_plan
function.description: Generates a full seasonal plan with stage-wise schedule, input requirements, and activity milestones for a horticulture crop. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT guarantee yield. Plan is advisory only. Fails if crop-location-season combination unsupported.
